name: Theobromine
summary: Theobromine is the principal bitter alkaloid of the cacao bean. It has been used in various pharmaceutical products as a vasodilator, diuretic, and heart stimulant. Theobromine is consumed in cocoa, chocolate, and in various forms of chocolate-based foods. It is also present in small amounts in green coffee beans, tea, mate, and kola nut.
